# Alphabet Deep Dive Analysis

Report 084 | Published 2022-05-15 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2022-5-15/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/084.json)

Policy timing, crypto failure and Alphabet.

This report contains several unusually testable calls. The Fed-pause deadline and six-to-twelve-month Treasury thesis failed; the named deferred oil contract also settled below its quoted entry reference. Alphabet and Bitcoin appreciated over the first three years of their three-to-five-year theses, with substantial interim volatility. Core Scientific's bankruptcy is a material company-selection miss. The Terra discussion largely repeats an already successful prior warning and should not inflate forecast counts. Conditional risks and valuation opinions are retained without forcing binary grades.

**Coverage:** All article text blocks were read. Ledger covers material macro, investment, and causal propositions; incidental descriptive statistics, boilerplate, and unreasoned position lists are excluded. Image labels were read, not image pixels.

## Claims

### 084-C01

**Soft landing unlikely**

| Field | Assessment |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Wrong |
| Type | forecast |
| Horizon | Current tightening cycle |
| Conditions | Not specified |
| Author modality | probably |
| Asset or variable | fed-tightening-recession |
| Source blocks | 9, 13, 14, 15 |
| Thesis family | fed-tightening-recession |

The preferred near-cycle recession outcome did not occur in the 2022-24 tightening/disinflation episode: NBER dates no recession, real GDP continued growing, and annual CPI fell to 3% by June 2024. An eventual unrelated recession would not rescue this episode-specific call.

**Direction:** Contradicted within the defined test.

**Timing:** Assessed against the stated horizon: Current tightening cycle

**Mechanism:** A matching outcome alone does not establish causation.

**Reviewer confidence:** medium

**Outcome evidence:**

- [Business Cycle Dating](https://www.nber.org/research/business-cycle-dating) | NBER | Verified in the audit

Official chronology identifies April 2020 as the pandemic recession trough; no 2022 recession is dated.

- [Real GDP](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/GDPC1) | BEA via FRED | 2026-11-07 | Verified in the audit

Real GDP rose from 22001.640bn inQ 42021 to 22272.546bn inQ 42022, about 1.23%, versus about 4.24% fromQ 12021 toQ 42021 alone.

- [CPI, June 2024](https://www.bls.gov/news.release/archives/cpi_07112024.htm) | BLS | 2024-07-11 | Verified in the audit

June 2024 annual CPI inflation was 3.0%.

## Framework lessons

## Verification limitations

- Captured website text is not an authenticated publication-date version.
- Chart-only numerical claims have not been visually verified.
- Selected stock/ETF adjusted-close comparisons are disclosed where used; no reconstructed portfolio backtest has been performed.
- Unresolved verdicts are not forecast failures or successes; no aggregate hit rate is inferred.
